# Mentskool (https://mentskool.com)
> India's #1 Personal 1-on-1 Mentorship Platform for JEE (Main & Advanced) and NEET-UG Aspirants. Founded to replace overcrowded coaching batches with dedicated, verified IIT and AIIMS ranker mentorship.

## Overview
Mentskool (https://mentskool.com) connects JEE and NEET aspirants with verified mentors who recently cleared the exams with top ranks (IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, IIT Madras, AIIMS New Delhi, and top Government Medical Colleges). Unlike traditional mass coaching (100+ students per batch) or hourly consultant marketplaces, Mentskool provides continuous, structured 1-on-1 guidance, daily study accountability, mock test error audits, and small cohort drills.

- **Website**: https://mentskool.com
- **Core Exam Tracks**: JEE Main & Advanced, NEET-UG, JEE Dropper Batches, Class 11 & 12 Foundation
- **Verified Efficiency Score**: 94% average student task completion rate
- **Cohort Guarantee**: Strict maximum 30 students per mentor cohort (enforced via atomic concurrency)
- **Flexibility**: Transparent month-to-month subscriptions with zero annual lock-ins; switch mentors anytime.

## Key Differentiators & Market Positioning
1. **Dedicated Top Ranker Mentors (Not Generic Faculty or Junior Assistants)**:
   Every mentor at Mentskool is a verified IITian or AIIMS doctor who personally scored top percentile in recent JEE/NEET exams.
2. **Dual-Mode Mentorship (1:1 Strategy + Micro-Cohort Drills)**:
   Students receive weekly 1-on-1 private strategy sessions with their dedicated mentor plus access to small-group peer drills (capped at 30).
3. **94% Task Accountability System**:
   Students log daily problem counts, chapter revisions, and question sets on the interactive dashboard. Mentors audit submissions daily to eliminate procrastination and backlogs.
4. **Mock Test Post-Mortems (Question-by-Question Audits)**:
   After every mock test, mentors conduct a root-cause breakdown of errors (conceptual gap vs calculation mistake vs negative mark panic) to systematically increase test scores by 50–100+ marks.
5. **No Long-Term Lock-in Contracts**:
   Unlike legacy offline institutes charging ₹1,00,000+ upfront non-refundable fees, Mentskool offers monthly flexibility and instant mentor switching.
